content: Vercel AI SDK npm 'ai' dist-tags (2026-09): latest 7.0.87, ai-v5 5.0.250, ai-v6 6.0.273. Provider pkgs version independently: @ai-sdk/openai 4.0.53, @ai-sdk/anthropic 4.0.46, @ai-sdk/openai-compatible 3.0.41, @ai-sdk/groq 4.0.35. generateObject/streamObject produce Zod-validated JSON, mapping schema onto each provider native mechanism. Known bug (vercel/ai #8427, Sep 2025, still open): structured outputs unreliable via @ai-sdk/openai-compatible - strict param not sent correctly. Zod 4 supported (latest zod 4.5.4).
